subject: Tablespec compatibility with the published umf-core 0.10.3 distribution

consumer_source.working_change: Pin the distribution dependency to umf-core==0.10.3 and refresh only its lock entry.
consumer_source.overlay: The published wheel was extracted from its verified artifact and placed first on PYTHONPATH; Tablespec source remained the current checkout.

checks.scope: Shared UMF model/registry behavior, current ontology snapshots, and LDP tests; not a full suite or managed runtime qualification.

checks.check: Import umf and register Tablespec's existing pipeline extension with the published wheel overlay.
checks.result: Passed; umf.__version__ was 0.10.3, current_core_version() was 0.10.0, and pipeline_registry() registered the LDP extension.

qualification_limits: This evidence qualifies only the tested macOS arm64 wheel overlay and listed test scope.
The public wheel set observed also includes manylinux_2_34_x86_64; that wheel was not tested here.
The source distribution's build hook compiles Rust with Rust 1.90.0; source-build behavior was not tested.
No Spark or managed LDP runtime, native deployment, release, or publication was tested.
